definitions.explanation: A prefix meaning 'first' or 'for the first time,' attached to nouns to indicate the first occurrence of something.

examples.japanese: {初|はつ}{体験|たいけん}だった。
{今年|ことし}の{初|はつ}{雪|ゆき}が{降|ふ}った。
examples.english: The first snow of the year fell.

examples.japanese: この{映画|えいが}は{初|はつ}{公開|こうかい}の{日|ひ}にチケットが{完売|かんばい}した。
examples.english: Tickets for this movie sold out on its opening day.

notes:
USAGE:
Attaches directly to nouns: {初|はつ}〜. Very productive — can combine with a wide range of nouns. Some combinations are established set words, while others can be formed freely.

COMPOUNDS:
- {初|はつ}{雪|ゆき}: first snow (of the season)
- {初|はつ}{恋|こい}: first love
- {初|はつ}{日|ひ}の{出|で}: first sunrise (of the year)
- {初|はつ}{詣|もうで}: first shrine visit (of the year)
- {初|はつ}{出場|しゅつじょう}: first appearance/participation
- {初|はつ}{優勝|ゆうしょう}: first championship
- {初|はつ}{体験|たいけん}: first experience

SIMILAR PREFIXES:
{初|しょ}〜 is the on'yomi reading used in more formal/Sino-Japanese compounds: {初期|しょき} (initial period), {初歩|しょほ} (basics).
